name: mathguard
description: Verify the maths in answers: identities, derivations, units, worked solutions and graded results, with SymPy and Pint.
long_description: mathguard checks mathematical claims deterministically instead of trusting the model. It finds the first wrong step in a worked solution (Markdown with LaTeX), checks identities, derivatives, integrals and units with a concrete counterexample when they fail, and grades final answers against a reference: formulas symbolically, numbers with unit conversion and rounding.

tools.name: check_solution
tools.description: Check a whole worked solution (Markdown with LaTeX) step by step and report the first wrong line.

tools.name: check_answer
tools.description: Grade the final results of an answer against a reference: formulas symbolically, numbers with units and rounding.

tools.name: check_derivation
tools.description: Check a derivation step by step; reports which step is wrong.

tools.name: check_identity
tools.description: Check that two expressions are equal for all values, with a counterexample if not.

tools.name: check_units
tools.description: Check an equation for dimensional consistency.

tools.name: verify_math
tools.description: Run several checks at once: equal, chain, derivative, antiderivative, definite_integral, solutions, value, limit, dimensions.
